Jobs @ KMRLTraining @ KMRLJobs @ CSMLJobs @ Water MetroPUBLIC NOTICEBEWARE OF FAKE JOB OPENINGS IN KOCHI METRO.It has come to our notice that some unscrupulous elements are trying to deceive candidates/general public by sending e-mails or through social media like WhatsApp, etc. by offering jobs to them in Kochi Metro. We also fear that these unscrupulous elements may collect money from the candidates/general public by giving promise of facilitating appointments in Kochi Metro.
Recruitment in KMRL is not out-sourced to any agency. All the vacancies in Kochi Metro are advertised in the newspapers and also in the employment news. The detailed advertisements mentioning the eligibility criteria for the advertised positions, including qualifications, age, experience required etc. are invariably hosted on our websitewww.kochimetro.org. Application in any other mode is not entertained by Kochi Metro. Kochi metro neither recruit anyone on the strength of his/her resume/biodata nor offer out-of-turn employment to anyone.We hereby caution the general public not to fall prey to claims made by unscrupulous elements aiming at fleecing money from the innocent public. It is requested to the public to not to believe any advertisement/job announcement of Kochi Metro circulated through e-mail, social media, messages etc.  Kochi Metro Rail Limited will not be responsible in any way to any individual heeding to the actions of these unscrupulous elements purporting to be representing Kochi Metro.
